```{r}

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_indispo_merge)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_indispo_merge))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "day_ahead_forecast",  "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables",
    "NTC_FR_ESP", "NTC_ESP_FR","gen_tot_da" , "gen_tot_da_conso" ,"gen_tot_da_net"
    )

price_indispo_merge[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_indispo_merge[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
#
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(
    #Planned.Unavailable.Capacity = Planned.Unavailable.Capacity - Planned.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
    Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity = Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity - Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
    temperature_mismatch = temperature_supply - temperature_demand
         ) 

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[complete.cases(price_indispo_merge),]

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[!rowSums(sapply(price_indispo_merge, is.infinite)), ]

price_indispo_merge$weekday <- weekdays(price_indispo_merge$delivery_date)
price_indispo_merge$creneau <- hour(price_indispo_merge$datetime)

colnames(price_indispo_merge)
```

On simplifie sans regarder les différences published/Unpublished Uneffective pour avoir des spécifications plus simples.





```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_log <- lm(
  log(price) ~  Published.Unavailable.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + 
     Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    + gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast,
  data= price_indispo_merge)

# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_log, type = "HC0")
cl_se_log<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster_unavailable  <- vcovCL(m_log, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_id)
cl_se_log_unavailable <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
vcov_cluster_nu <- vcovCL(m_log, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_nu_id)
cl_se_log_nu <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster_nu))

unavailable_names <- names(coefficients(m_log))[grep("Unavailable", names(coefficients(m_log)))]
nuclear_names <- names(coefficients(m_log))[grep("Nuclear", names(coefficients(m_log)))]
cl_se_log[unavailable_names] <- cl_se_log_unavailable[unavailable_names]
cl_se_log[nuclear_names] <- cl_se_log_nu[nuclear_names]




m_log_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + 
     Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast  + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
  data= price_indispo_merge)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_log_FE, type = "HC0")
cl_se_log_FE<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster_unavailable  <- vcovCL(m_log_FE, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_id)
cl_se_log_unavailable <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
vcov_cluster_nu <- vcovCL(m_log_FE, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_nu_id)
cl_se_log_nu <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster_nu))

unavailable_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_FE))[grep("Unavailable", names(coefficients(m_log_FE)))]
nuclear_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_FE))[grep("Nuclear", names(coefficients(m_log_FE)))]
cl_se_log_FE[unavailable_names] <- cl_se_log_unavailable[unavailable_names]
cl_se_log_FE[nuclear_names] <- cl_se_log_nu[nuclear_names]


m_log_control <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity + 
     Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+
    gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast   +
    spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
  data= price_indispo_merge)

# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_log_control, type = "HC0")
cl_se_log_control<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster_unavailable  <- vcovCL(m_log_control, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_id)
cl_se_log_unavailable <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
vcov_cluster_nu <- vcovCL(m_log_control, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_nu_id)
cl_se_log_nu <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster_nu))

unavailable_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Unavailable", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
nuclear_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Nuclear", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
cl_se_log_control[unavailable_names] <- cl_se_log_unavailable[unavailable_names]
cl_se_log_control[nuclear_names] <- cl_se_log_nu[nuclear_names]


```



```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer( m_log, m_log_FE, m_log_control, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_log, cl_se_log_FE, cl_se_log_control),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE", "Time FE+ Controls"),
    keep = c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Planned.Unavailable.Capacity", "Published.Unavailable.Capacity", 
     "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity","UnPublished.Unavailable.Capacity", 
     "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity"  ,
     "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
    "UnPublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "Planned.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","gen_tot",
             "day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables")
)
 
```



```{r}
# perform first stage regression
m_rf <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
     gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas,
  data= price_indispo_merge)


vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
cl_se_rf <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# # Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
# vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# # Erreurs standard clusterisées
# cl_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# rf_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Predicted", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
# cl_se_rf[rf_names] <- cl_se[rf_names]


m_rf_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~  Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    gen_tot+ day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas + 
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday),
  data= price_indispo_merge)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_FE , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_FE <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


```



```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer(  m_rf, m_rf_FE,  
    type = "html",
    se = list( cl_se_rf, cl_se_rf_FE),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c(  "XGB", "XGB + Time FE"),
    keep = c("Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "UnPublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
              "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Planned.Limiting.Capacity",
    "Published.Limiting.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Capacity", "UnPublished.Limiting.Capacity",
      "gen_tot",
             "day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables")
)
```
